lessons.trigger: Win32 API mock tests pass on Linux
lessons.rule: Do not label this native Windows validation; keep runtime gate blocked

lessons.trigger: An exception occurs after opening ancestor handles
lessons.rule: Close every successfully opened handle in reverse order

lessons.trigger: Root or ancestor has reparse-point attribute
lessons.rule: Reject immediately and do not proceed to descendant reads

lessons.trigger: ReadFile returns EOF before declared size
lessons.rule: Fail closed on size mismatch rather than accept a partial digest

lessons.trigger: Volume, file index, timestamps or attributes change during capture
lessons.rule: Reject snapshot; stable metadata is still not cryptographic authenticity

lessons.trigger: ctypes.wintypes is used on non-Windows Python
lessons.rule: Do not assume native Win32 type sizes or behavior from Linux simulator

lessons.trigger: A hash-only snapshot is mistaken for a Civil NX result
lessons.rule: Require independent completion evidence and authentic numerical table before engineering certification
